cli_blocking_reason: evaluation.py line 262 sets DEBUG=True, which overwrites sys.argv with hardcoded /tmp/ntcir19_fehu/... paths before argparse runs. Any --gold_task1/--pred_task1b arguments are ignored and the process fails with FileNotFoundError on the hardcoded test path (verified: exit code 1 in the dry-run). The CLI therefore cannot score arbitrary files as shipped.
approved_evaluator_invocation_method: Import evaluation.py as a module and call its official functions programmatically. Importing is side-effect free because main() runs only under `if __name__ == "__main__"`. Do NOT invoke the CLI for arbitrary files and do NOT modify evaluation.py.

official_functions_to_use.parse_task1b: parse_task1b(path) -> Dict[(guid,actor), Set['{direction}:{l1}']]; validates/accepts the Task-1b JSON format.
official_functions_to_use.evaluate: evaluate(gold, pred, l1_dir_universe()) -> {micro_f1, macro_f1, micro_precision, micro_recall, support_*}.

evaluation_py_internal_naming.note: DRR internal variables treat 0=aligned, 1=contradictory (INVERTED vs authoritative). Symmetric aggregates are unaffected; do not narrate direction meaning from evaluation.py variable names.
